intro: Limit profiles cap each bound node separately: download and upload speed, open connections and the times it may use the VPN. A node’s own profile wins over its group’s.
notEnforcing: The firewall runs in iptables mode, which does not enforce limits. Switch to the nftables engine (FIREWALL_ENGINE=nft) to apply them.
loadError: Failed to load the limit profiles
emptyHint: Create a profile, then bind it to nodes or groups.
name: Name
bindingsHint: Saving applies the limits at once. A node bound here uses this profile even if its group has another.
deleteConfirm: Delete limit profile {{name}}? A profile bound to nodes or groups cannot be deleted.
perNodeHint: Every node gets these limits on its own; they are not shared.
scheduleNone: No windows: the VPN can be used at any time.
scheduleHint: Outside these windows the node’s VPN traffic is cut off.

errors.speed: Speeds must be positive numbers in Mbit/s (at most 100000), or empty.
errors.connections: Open connections must be a positive whole number, or empty.
errors.noDays: Every window needs at least one day.
